meta.convention: UPPER_LIMB_REFRACTED (visible = first..last instant of the interval with altitude >= threshold)

fragile.tags: kind (magnitude/centrality margin), vis (horizon crossing near interval end), C:<contact> (contact rate below the limit; both levels)

meta.globalRow: [solar 0|1, greatestMs, gammaDeg (min angle, geocentric; lunar: Moon-antisolar, solar: Moon-Sun), lunarKind|null, umbralMag|null, penumbralMag|null, [[contact,ms,rateArcsecPerSec]], curvArcsecPerSec2, eclipse 0|1 (0 = near-miss within 0.02 of the limit, kind null), fragP[], fragB[], solarMargin|null = (limit-gamma)/(2 s_S)]; sorted (greatest, solar); lunar contacts P1,U1,U2,U3,U4,P4 as applicable; solar global contacts not defined
meta.localRow: [globalIndex, kind|null, magnitude (solar: obscuration-free magnitude (s'S+s'M-sigma)/(2 s'S); lunar: umbral, penumbral for LUNAR_PENUMBRAL), maxAtMs, [[contact,ms,rate]] (solar C1..C4; lunar [] = see global row), visibleStartMs|null, visibleEndMs|null, sutakStartMs|null, sutakEndMs|null, fragP[], fragB[] (solar: kind, vis, C:<contact>; lunar: vis only, kind/contact fragility is read from the global row), [sigmaMin, s'S, s'M] arcsec|null (solar)]; solar rows only where sigma_min < s'S+s'M or within 0.02 of it (kind null, magnitude <= 0); lunar rows for every lunar eclipse; sorted (maxAt, globalIndex)

sutak.rule: only if visible and not penumbral; solar [C1-43200 s, C4], lunar [U1-32400 s, U4]
